definitions.explanation: An unmanned vehicle or device sent to investigate or gather data, especially in space exploration.

examples.japanese: {火星|かせい}{探査機|たんさき}が{着陸|ちゃくりく}した。
{探査機|たんさき}が{送|おく}ってきた{画像|がぞう}が{公開|こうかい}された。
examples.english: Images sent back by the probe were released to the public.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{小惑星|しょうわくせい}{探査機|たんさき}が{地球|ちきゅう}にサンプルを{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}ることに{成功|せいこう}した。
examples.english: Japan's asteroid probe succeeded in bringing samples back to Earth.

notes:
{探査|たんさ} (exploration, probing) + {機|き} (machine, device). Most commonly used in the context of space exploration to refer to unmanned spacecraft. Can also refer to deep-sea probes or other remote exploration devices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {惑星|わくせい}{探査機|たんさき} — planetary probe
- {月|つき}{探査機|たんさき} — lunar probe
- {小惑星|しょうわくせい}{探査機|たんさき} — asteroid probe
- {深海|しんかい}{探査機|たんさき} — deep-sea probe
- {無人|むじん}{探査機|たんさき} — unmanned probe

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's はやぶさ (Hayabusa) asteroid probe became a national sensation when it returned samples from the asteroid Itokawa in 2010. Its successor, {はやぶさ2|はやぶさに}, completed a similar mission to asteroid Ryugu in 2020.
